title: Check a private export's tenant binding
hypothesis: A completed private export may lose its tenant authorization binding
observed_clue: Replace with a captured route or source location
invariant: Only a current member of the owning tenant can download its private export
benign_alternative: The export is intentionally shared or the test session is still an owner
prerequisites: Known private canary in owned export
baseline: Owner can download the synthetic canary
control: Known inaccessible owned fixture produces the documented denial under nonmember-b
test: Request the exact seeded export once as nonmember-b
repeat: Repeat with fresh controlled fixture and verified identity
oracle: Private canary is returned under the verified nonmember identity
stop: Stop after proof, missing control, ownership uncertainty, unexpected real data or budget limit
